onboardingEntryReview: Compared with 550ef281: first gender selection is extracted into a stateless accessible component. Its save handler, render condition and audience enforcement are unchanged. The home invitation appears after audience resolution, links guests to signup with a separate existing-member login, and avoids duplicate draft prompts. check-onboarding-polish pins all home handle/reload handlers. check-entry-profile-flow-browser covers guest/new/unverified/draft/existing/missing/error states, notification login returns and 320/390/1280 widths; check-onboarding-polish-browser covers gender save failure/retry/reload, keyboard, state preservation and color schemes.
contactCancelReview: Compared with 197bc3c: My Page changes only ONE_ON_ONE_CONTACT_CANCEL_DELAY_MS from 48 to 72 hours. Matching, checkout, phone disclosure and support entry handlers unchanged. check-contact-care covers both UI guards, real cancellation API/SQL boundaries and canceled-match claim access.
friendShareReview: Compared with bd9d118: additive sharing buttons/settings/admin tab only; existing matching and payment handlers unchanged. New UI/API/privacy gates and signup return covered by check-friend-recommendation and browser tests.
friendBasketReview: Compared with 60e02f6: home only imports and renders FriendRecommendationBasketButton for authenticated open-card/one-on-one tabs. All existing handlers are unchanged. Compact basket, mixed-card selection, max-three limit, duplicate retry keys, removal and session reset covered by check-friend-basket-browser on Chromium and WebKit.
contextualOffersReview: Home navigation is compact with quota-zero offers only for verified known users. Existing home handlers unchanged. Apply page replaces only DAILY_APPLY_LIMIT presentation, retaining checkout lock, draft, return URL and submission handlers. Covered by check-contextual-paid-offers(-browser), check-apply-credit-checkout, check-city-preview-and-card-order, check-profile-writing-browser and check-revenue-journey-browser. Existing matching, fulfillment and phone-disclosure rules are unchanged.
